title: Pass package.json team as owner in core-shell, billing, reports
Build all three apps, open PR, CI, merge, confirm CD

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty/non-string. core-shell='platform', billing='payments', reports='insights' passed as owner (copied from each app's package.json team; hardcoded because libs/apps are inlined into bundles and can't import package.json). All three apps built locally; CI and CD green via PR #1. Assumption: single PR in mono since the shared contract lives there; no registry libs involved.
